title: RepoMesh External Member Binding v2
description: Versioned response RepoMesh preflight returns to a Bridge instance during startup, after local schema/profile/credential-ref validation and before Matrix sync or any CLI process is spawned. v2 is v1 plus exactly one new required field, `role`, confirmed from RepoMesh's own agent directory rather than echoed back from the enrollment document: an enrollment/binding role mismatch is a preflight failure, not a value the Bridge may resolve locally. It binds the RepoMesh principal id to the AgentTeams resource name, the Matrix user id, and the authoritative role-aware allowed room ids, and confirms containerManaged: false plus the organization/team. Contains no secrets and no Go Controller addresses; the Bridge talks only to RepoMesh, never to the AgentTeams Go Controller directly.

role.description: RepoMesh role on file for this member, as confirmed by RepoMesh's own agent directory. Must equal the enrollment's role; a mismatch is a preflight failure. organization_leader is not representable and is rejected at provision time.

workerAgentId.description: RepoMesh AgentPrincipal id RepoMesh has on file for this member. Historical field name kept from v1. Must equal the enrollment's workerAgentId; a mismatch is a preflight failure, not a value the Bridge may override.

workerName.description: AgentTeams Worker resource name, as confirmed by RepoMesh's own AgentTeams projection, not merely echoed back from the enrollment document. Historical field name kept from v1.

matrixUserId.description: Matrix user id RepoMesh has on file for this member identity.

allowedRoomIds.description: Authoritative role-aware room allowlist as known to RepoMesh/AgentTeams team membership: team room plus worker DM for a worker, team room plus leader DM for a repository_leader. The Bridge must use the intersection of this list and its enrollment allowedRoomIds; RepoMesh is the source of truth for room ownership, not the enrollment document.

containerManaged.description: Confirms the member is provisioned as an external member. A preflight response for a containerManaged: true resource is a validation failure, not a valid binding; this field is always false when the response is well-formed.
